fixed: The coffee counter was drawn too small and its price sign ran off the left edge: the counter is a third larger and the sign moved in; the three bars said 20% twice each, so they are labelled LOW, MIDDLE, HIGH.
notes: The first video in the new look Biku picked (the 2.5D world, deep ocean colours). Looked at three frames a second across the whole part: the question builds word by word over the counter; the camera dives into the tablet and closes in on the buttons on 'buttons'; 72% counts up on the coin; the queue walks in under TIP?; the tablet turns from its back to face you on 'screen'; the three buttons become the 20, 25 and 30 percent blocks, rising on their words. Nothing appears or vanishes without a move.
Refined with his OK in two lines of part 3 (the coffee shop study found the opposite of the old line); part 1 is his words.
The queue is still drawn flat, in front of the 2.5D floor; the people could be drawn in the world later.
The narrator is the studio's placeholder voice. Claude cannot hear: the voice, music and sounds need Biku's ears.
